RT by @jimcramer: 3. Data center exposure "We have more data center exposure than some would think is safe, but I don’t see any end yet to the buildout. I think there’s much more to come. That’s why we like Eaton and GE Vernova so much. GE Vernova takes natural gas and turns it into electricity and either passes it on to Eaton for transmission or sends it right into the center itself. They are partners and competitors."

RT by @jimcramer: 2. Apple "We aren’t trading it, but my fondness for Tim Cook is so great that it will be difficult for me to be as confident with a new CEO. Don’t yet make a judgment on that as I think that there are only two business people in this world I trust more than all others: Jensen Huang and Tim Cook."

RT by @jimcramer: 1. The market "Lots of people are yammering about how the 30-year Treasury sports the highest interest rate in 19 years. True. But oil is behind so much of inflation that it’s too murky to figure what the rate should be. The fact is profits, my barometer, are pretty darned fantastic. The consumer is strong. Spending is fine, not excessive. And we have the most amazing transformational economy I have ever seen, one that involves artificial intelligence that is revolutionizing everything. As long as these two themes continue working we will do just fine."
